title: Youth Congress workers detained over protest against Meta for blocking social media accounts

ai.summary: Twenty-one Youth Congress workers were detained by police after protesting Meta's alleged blocking of their social media accounts and removal of posts, claiming it silenced opposition voices.

facts.claim: Twenty-one Youth Congress workers, including State president Siva Charan Reddy, were detained by Raidurgam police in Cyberabad on Friday (November 20, 2026) after they staged a protest against Meta over the alleged blocking of their social media accounts and removal of posts.
facts.quote: Twenty-one Youth Congress workers, including State president Siva Charan Reddy, were detained by Raidurgam police in Cyberabad on Friday (November 20, 2026) after they staged a protest against Meta over the alleged blocking of their social media accounts and removal of posts.

facts.claim: The protesters alleged that the platform had restricted their accounts and removed several posts, claiming that it was an attempt to silence opposition voices.
facts.quote: The protesters alleged that the platform had restricted their accounts and removed several posts, claiming that it was an attempt to silence opposition voices.

facts.claim: An officer from Raidurgam Police Station said the protesters had entered the Skyview building during the demonstration. A total of 21 workers were detained and released after about three hours.
facts.quote: An officer from Raidurgam Police Station said the protesters had entered the Skyview building during the demonstration. A total of 21 workers were detained and released after about three hours.

facts.claim: The Indian Youth Congress later claimed that its president’s and other functionaries’ Instagram accounts were restored within 15 minutes of the protest.
facts.quote: The Indian Youth Congress later claimed that its president’s and other functionaries’ Instagram accounts were restored within 15 minutes of the protest.

facts.claim: The organisation accused Meta of selectively restricting opposition voices and warned that it would continue its protests against what it described as censorship.
facts.quote: The organisation accused Meta of selectively restricting opposition voices and warned that it would continue its protests against what it described as censorship.
